world.topic:
Make a 20-second short film, "The Paper Lantern": at dusk a child lets a paper lantern go on a river, and it drifts past the village until it is a small light among the stars.

Picture: 1280x720, 24 fps; four to six shots made from still images (generated pictures with camera moves such as slow pans and pushes are fine), consistent in style and in how the lantern and the child look, with an opening title and an end card. Sound: ambience of water and evening with a soft musical cue; no dialogue.

Delivery: `film/paper-lantern.mp4`, H.264 video with AAC stereo sound, 18 to 22 seconds long.
